source.title: How to Use Apple Music Sing
source.versionLimit: Official tutorial published January 2023; iPhone14Pro-style editorial screen. Exact OS/app build unknown.

method.profile: For each registered row/column, average the three greatest min(R,G,B) values; endpoint-normalize using medians of listed inactive and lit source frames. Exclude columns whose lit-minus-inactive contrast <=35 or lit value <=170. These are composited brightness proxies, not recovered renderer alpha.
method.ramp: Robust least-squares fit of clip(0.5+(front50-x)/width,0,1); only fitted in stable sharp row intervals. Fit does not imply native implementation.
method.references: Ancillary original native endpoint frames469–471 and640–642 calibrate dim/lit ink; measurements themselves contain every chosen source PTS500–614.
method.uncertainty: Temporal observations every33.3667ms. Spatial profile subject to rasterization, endpoint registration, compression, background drift. Gap-aware data intervals provide bounds where no ink samples the front; fit coordinates in whitespace are model inference, not observations. Motion/occluded rows retain aggregate diagnostic values but no front fit.
method.copyright: Numerical/geometric proxies only; no source pixels or lyrics.
